items.assessment: Independently read the complete replacement. Repeated small voids, elevated lateral fundal displacement persisting after tone firms, and stable circulation support focused bladder-emptying assessment and the prescribed postpartum voiding plan with reassessment. Alternatives are parallel relevant postpartum assessments for afterpains, bleeding/tone and retained tissue. The key is not uniquely long and does not authorize automatic catheterization without the plan. This objective is distinct from emergency postpartum haemorrhage response in legacyadaptation08.
